title.suggested: Tom Allen's Free Concert Hall Advertised

summary.suggested: The Daily Missouri Democrat carried a notice for Tom Allen's Free Concert Hall at 417 Washington Avenue, 'best place of amusement in the city,' open every evening with the champion presiding.
